title: Hearty Grassy Middle Eastern Lentils Mujadara
description: A flavorful and nutritious Middle Eastern dish featuring little gem lettuce and lardons, served in a traditional mujadara style on a wooden board.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the rinsed lentils and enough water to cover them, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the lentils for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, render the lardons in a pan over medium heat until they are crispy.
Chop the little gem lettuce and set it aside.
To serve, place a portion of the cooked lentils on a wooden board, then top with chopped lettuce, crispy lardons, and a drizzle of olive oil.
